answer_2.quote: In our dataset, we utilize two primary metrics for evaluating LLMs: Accuracy This metric is computed using the formula acc = (T P +T N )/(T P +T N +F P +F N ).

answer_4.quote: two native speakers of English were required to assess a randomly selected sample of 220 sentences from our dataset.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators were required to answer four questions for each sentence: i) Is the sentence true or false?, ii) is the sentence grammatically correct?, iii) is the sentence understandable? and iv) is the sentence plausible and might be produced by a speaker?
